content.title: About
content.content: Cereal, K's, flavored is a ready‑to‑eat dry breakfast cereal enriched with vitamins and minerals and flavored with natural aromatics. Served with milk or yogurt, it provides quick energy and a satisfying start to the day.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The K's brand is known for high‑quality ingredients and natural flavorings.
Dry cereals often contain whole grains that retain most of their dietary fiber.
Formulations frequently include iron and vitamin B12, making them suitable for vegetarians.
Packaging usually includes preparation instructions that take only 2‑3 minutes.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2, B6 and B12 support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Iron contributes to hemoglobin formation and helps prevent anemia.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and promotes a feeling of fullness.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Most calories come from carbohydrates, making it a good energy source.

items.title: Fortified with calcium
items.content: Calcium is essential for strong bones and teeth.

items.title: Cereal allergy
items.content: Some individuals may react to wheat, barley or oats present in the product.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: The cereal can raise blood sugar quickly, which may be unsuitable for diabetics.

items.title: Added sugar content
items.content: Certain flavored versions contain noticeable amounts of sugar, which should be considered in a balanced diet.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour 200 ml of milk or plant‑based beverage, add 30‑40 g of cereal, stir and let sit for 2‑3 minutes. Fresh berries, nuts or honey can be added for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the bag tightly sealed to maintain crispness.
